set.body:
Scope: Current MVPA/surface/provider tests, fixtures, examples and docs/plans/ecosystem-unification.md.

Deliverable: Map the existing test corpus to destinations and capture the smallest current baseline per boundary. Define three composition specimens: domain/duplicate draw, volume plus mesh frame, and response-to-MVPA provenance.

Acceptance:
- Each moved fixture/tool has one destination; external consumers and current failures/caveats are listed.
- Baseline commands and revisions are recorded with real exit outcomes; no new performance or scientific qualification is implied.
- Target specimens specify expected results and current provider gaps; provider-only tests cannot import ScalaFIM.

Apply the shared migration and verification requirements in eco-unification.
set.title: U0: Capture existing contracts and composition specimens
